description: List appointment groups you can sign up for, such as office hours or advising slots, with open time slots. Read-only. Book a slot with reserve_appointment_slot.

include_past.description: If true, also include appointment groups whose slots are in the past.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

scope.description: "reservable" (default: groups you can still book) or "manageable".

name: list_appointment_groups
title: List Appointment Groups
